_comment: Copy to arena.config.json. Model ids change often: check each provider's model list and run `node src/cli.js check` before a real match.

bridge._comment: Only for `node src/cli.js real`: the real Among Us through the AUBridge mod (docs/REAL_GAME.md). gamePath: your Among Us.exe with BepInEx and AUBridge installed. lobby: options sent to the host copy. window (e.g. "1920x1080") and sound: true open every copy windowed at that size with its sound on, to record each one on its own. freeze (default true): game time stands still while any brain is thinking, so slow models lose no time. impostors: seat ids that play the impostors instead of a random pick (1 from 4 players, 2 from 7, 3 from 9).

seats._comment: Subscription seats: no API key, they run your signed-in CLI (README: Playing on a subscription). Set enabled to true to use one; a match takes 4 to 10 enabled seats.
